targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "vus" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT count("value") FROM "http_reqs" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)
SELECT mean("value") FROM "http_req_failed" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

panels.title: Response Time by Endpoint (p95, ms) - grouped by real hit URL
panels.description: Grouped by the "name" tag, set to the actual endpoint/URL each scenario hit (see k6/lib/config.js ENDPOINTS / FRONTEND_ROUTES).

targets.query: SELECT percentile("value", 95) FROM "http_req_duration" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "name" fill(null)

panels.title: Hit URLs - Requests, Avg Duration, Failure Rate
panels.description: Every real URL/endpoint hit during the run (the "name"/"url" tags set in k6/scenarios/*.js), with request count and average duration per URL.

targets.query: SELECT count("value") AS "requests", mean("value") AS "avg_ms" FROM "http_req_duration" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "name", "url"

panels.title: Browser Scenario - Real-Page Load Time (p95, ms)
panels.description: browser_http_req_duration from k6/scenarios/browser-login.js (headless Chromium), tagged per navigation URL automatically by the browser module.

targets.query: SELECT percentile("value", 95) FROM "browser_http_req_duration" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "url" fill(null)
SELECT count("value") FROM "checks" WHERE $timeFilter AND "value" = 1 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)
SELECT count("value") FROM "checks" WHERE $timeFilter AND "value" = 0 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)
